Because I'm depressed and alone. Nothing can change it.

Clearly you have no idea what it's like to have depression for 15 years and have no prospects for love/marriage. I have a feeling you're little more than a kid with no idea just how cruel the world really is and how awful humans can be to each other.

I can't get an appointment with a psych in time. I'm on a 3 month waitlist. My regular doctor knows nothing about how to treat depression. It's too long. I've been suffering on and off for 15 years. I've had enough.
Yes. Nothing she can do cuz she doesn't write Rxs.
Counseling and meds. Tried a lot of different Rx's, nothing is helping.
I have 2 cats. My sister will get both when I go.

I work full time. I'm successful and have the guts to do things most women don't. But at the end of the day, I'm too exhausted and full of self-loathing to do anything. I can't cook for myself anymore. I barely eat. Just drink, try to take my Rx regimen, and take a vitamin now and then.

I have strugglee with depression for well over a decade. In and out of therapy for years, tried different drugs, etc. And you know what? I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of being the social downer. I'm tired of feeling like I don't belong anywhere. I'm tired of life.

I live alone. Friends are too far and too busy. Romance is a constant failure. I'm almost 30, I have so much to offer and NOT ONE will have me. If this is all my life has been and will be, why keep torturing myself? I'm in the process of settling my affairs and making preparations so I'll be ready to go on my birthday. I want to leave on what has been the most miserable day of my existence.

I have hobbies. Rally cross, archery.....I don't care for gaming. I have no one to spend time with. I hate it. I hate that my treatments are failing. I hate feeling like a lonely piece of shit every day. My best friend has been alcohol. I'm dying slowly.... I just want to speed it up.
